title: The Isomorphic Labs Drug Design Engine unlocks a new frontier beyond AlphaFold
summary: Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet's AI-driven drug discovery company, has developed a drug design engine that extends beyond AlphaFold's protein structure prediction capabilities to actively design therapeutic molecules, representing a significant advancement from structure prediction to molecular design in pharmaceutical research.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between predicting protein structures and actively designing new drug molecules that can effectively bind to target proteins.
why_valuable: Potentially accelerates drug discovery by orders of magnitude, moving from structure prediction to actionable therapeutic design using AI.
